ForgeChat Feature Guide

A simple, business-level tour of what ForgeChat does — organised into expandable sections, with screenshots so anyone on your team can understand the platform at a glance.

Version 1.0.1 WhatsApp Business Platform — Cloud API Self-hosted & private

You own your data

ForgeChat runs on your own server and connects directly to the WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API). Customer conversations, contacts and access tokens stay with you — encrypted and never handed to a third-party SaaS.

CATEGORY 01

Access & Team Control

Who can get in, and what each person is allowed to see.
Secure Sign-In

A private front door for your team.

Email & Password Login

DoesEach team member signs in with their own email and password over a secure, encrypted session.
WhyKeeps customer conversations private — only authorised staff can ever open the platform.

Show / Hide Password

DoesA one-tap toggle lets users reveal what they typed before signing in.
WhyFewer failed logins and a smoother first experience.
Users & Roles

Bring your whole team on board, with the right level of access for each person.

Multiple Team Accounts

DoesAdmins add team members and reset their passwords from Settings → Users.
WhyEveryone gets their own login — no shared passwords.

Role-Based Access

DoesAdmins see everything; Sales users see only the chats and contacts assigned to them.
WhyReps stay focused on their own customers; sensitive settings stay protected.

Per-Chat Assignment

DoesAny conversation can be assigned to a specific team member.
WhyClear ownership means no customer message slips through the cracks.

Fine-Grained Permissions

DoesGrant or remove access to individual pages for a single user, beyond their role.
WhyTailor exactly what each person can do without changing their role.
CATEGORY 02

Team Inbox & Conversations

One shared, WhatsApp-style screen for the whole team.
Shared WhatsApp Inbox

Read and reply to every customer from one place.

Unified Team Inbox

DoesA familiar three-pane layout: team numbers, conversation list, and the live chat thread.
WhyEveryone works from the same inbox — no more juggling a single business phone.

Rich Messaging

DoesSend text, images, video, documents and voice notes (record in-app), plus emoji reactions, replies and starring.
WhyHave complete, natural conversations exactly the way customers expect on WhatsApp.

24-Hour Window Guidance

DoesShows when WhatsApp's free-reply window is open and suggests a template when it has closed.
WhyStay within WhatsApp's rules and avoid messages that would be rejected.

Read & Delivery Status

DoesSee sent, delivered and read ticks, and mark conversations as read.
WhyKnow your message landed and keep the inbox tidy.
CATEGORY 03

Customer Management (CRM)

Keep every customer organised — your database, your rules.
Contact Database

A searchable home for all your customers.

Central Contact List

DoesEvery customer's name, number and details in one searchable, filterable list.
WhyYour customer data lives with you, ready whenever you need it.

Bulk Import

DoesUpload your contacts from an Excel/CSV file using a ready-made template.
WhyMove your existing customer list across in minutes.
Organise & Segment

Group and label customers so you always reach the right people.

Color-Coded Tags

DoesLabel contacts (Hot Lead, VIP, etc.) with colored tags.
WhySpot and group the right customers at a glance.

Tag Categories

DoesGroup related tags under categories such as "Lead Source" or "Admission".
WhyKeep long tag lists organised and easy to report on.

Custom Fields

DoesAdd your own fields — city, budget, lead score, date of birth and more (Text, Number or Date).
WhyCapture the exact information your business actually cares about.
Sales Pipeline

Turn conversations into closed deals.

Deals Pipeline (Kanban Board)

DoesTrack opportunities across stages on a drag-and-drop board; add multiple pipelines and deals.
WhySee your whole sales funnel and move deals forward with confidence.

Pipeline Metrics

DoesAt-a-glance totals for number of deals and pipeline value.
WhyUnderstand where revenue is sitting and what needs attention.
CATEGORY 04

Marketing & Outreach

Reach many customers at once — the compliant, policy-aligned way.
Message Templates

Design message templates that meet WhatsApp's template policy, with a live preview.

Template Builder + Live Preview

DoesBuild a template and watch a live phone preview update as you type.
WhyCreate professional, on-brand messages and get them right before submitting.

Template Approval Tracking

DoesSubmit a template and watch its review status update automatically through WhatsApp's approval workflow.
WhyKnow exactly when a template is approved and ready to send.

Test & Duplicate

DoesSend a test of any template to your own number, or duplicate one to start a new variant.
WhyReuse what works and verify before you send to customers.

Personalised Variables

DoesInsert placeholders like the customer's name that fill in automatically for each recipient.
WhyMass messages that still read as personal.

Bulk Broadcasts

Send one message to many — and see exactly what happened.

Broadcast Campaigns

DoesPick recipients, choose what to send, and launch a campaign to many contacts at once.
WhyReach your whole audience in a single campaign.

Live Delivery Tracking

DoesTrack each campaign as Sent, Partial or Failed, with per-recipient delivery status.
WhyMeasure reach and follow up exactly where it matters.

Test Before You Send

DoesSend a single test message to one number before committing to the full list.
WhyCatch a mistake before it reaches hundreds of customers.

Drafts & History

DoesSave broadcasts as drafts and review every past campaign by status.
WhyPlan ahead and keep a record of what you sent.

CATEGORY 05

Automation

Let ForgeChat answer for you — instantly, even after hours.
Auto-Reply Builder

Build automatic replies by dragging blocks — no coding.

Visual Flow Builder

DoesDrag blocks onto a canvas to create keyword-triggered auto-replies, with a built-in preview and test.
WhyAnswer common questions instantly — anyone can build a flow, no developer needed.

Keyword Triggers

DoesStart a flow when a message exactly matches, contains, or starts with a keyword.
WhyRespond to the things customers actually ask.

TextLink (with preview)ImageVideoAudioDocument

Commerce

Run History & Testing

See exactly what every automation did — and test before you go live.

Execution History

DoesEvery automation run is recorded step-by-step — which trigger fired, what was sent, and the delivery result.
WhyFull transparency: see what the system did and fix issues with confidence.

Preview & Test

DoesPreview a flow and send a test message to your own WhatsApp before enabling it.
WhyCatch mistakes before they ever reach a real customer.
Open the Executions tab on any automation to browse its run history, step by step.
CATEGORY 06

Platform & Settings

Connect WhatsApp and tailor the platform to your business.
WhatsApp Connection

Connect your WhatsApp Business Platform number, safely.

Connect WhatsApp Business

DoesLink your WhatsApp Business Platform number; access tokens are stored encrypted.
WhySend through the WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API — reliable, compliant, and aligned with WhatsApp's messaging policies.

Account Health Alerts

DoesThe platform flags an expired token or rate-limit problem on your connected number.
WhyCatch and fix issues before they interrupt your customer messaging.
Preferences & Privacy

Make ForgeChat comfortable — and keep it yours.

Self-Hosted & Private

DoesEverything runs on your own server; you control accounts and data, end to end.
WhyYou own your data — it never leaves your infrastructure.
